section1_context: PayFlow is a digital wallet / money-transfer reference application (Node20/TypeScript/Express5 backend, Prisma6 ORM over PostgreSQL16, React19/Vite/Tailwind frontend, npm-workspaces monorepo) built as a security-training lab rather than a production system. A customer can register, hold an INR wallet, top up via a simulated payment provider, send money to other registered users via email/phone lookup, manage beneficiaries, and view transaction history. The `main` branch is documented as a frozen 'clean' baseline (proper authz, validation, parameterized queries, argon2id hashing, audit logging, security headers, rate limiting). This checkout (`security-testing-v2`) is NOT that baseline: git history shows 18 branches (vuln-001..vuln-018), each documented as injecting exactly one CWE-mapped bug for a scanner-comparison exercise, and direct inspection of the current source confirms nearly all 18 are cumulatively merged into this branch's live code (confirmed by reading app.ts, transactions.service.ts, password.ts, users.schemas.ts, transfers.service.ts, errorHandler.ts, backend/package.json directly, not just git log). So for this checkout, threats are scored against the CURRENT vulnerable state, not a hypothetical. No containerization/CI/IaC exists yet; it runs as a local dev process against a local Postgres instance. Phase 3 (ops portal, roles) and Phase 4 (hardening) are specced but not built.

section2_assets.description: passwordHash, name, email, phone, dateOfBirth, address on User table
short-lived access JWT + rotating hashed refresh-token chain with reuse detection
Transaction table recording money movement; integrity/immutability matters as much as confidentiality
Beneficiary.identifier (email/phone) + name used to route transfers
AuditLog events (LOGIN, PASSWORD_CHANGE, TRANSFER_SENT, REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSE_DETECTED, etc.), no write-once/checksum enforcement observed
full DB reachable if query construction is unsafe; also dev-role credentials

section3_entry_points.description: gated by requireAuth, scoped by req.user.id in service layer
reads payflow_at httpOnly cookie, verifies JWT
cors({origin:true, credentials:true}) confirmed live in backend/src/app.ts:30 - reflects any Origin, allows credentials
section3_entry_points.trust_boundary: any external website -> victim's authenticated session

section3_entry_points.description: implemented in middleware/verifyOrigin.ts but confirmed NOT imported/mounted in app.ts
authLimiter defined in rateLimit.ts but confirmed never applied to any route; only blanket apiLimiter (300/15min) covers /api
confirmed: prisma.$queryRawUnsafe with q and wallet.id string-interpolated directly into SQL, ILIKE pattern, no validate() middleware on this route (unlike siblings)
section3_entry_points.trust_boundary: authenticated user input -> raw SQL against DB

section3_entry_points.description: getTransactionById (no ownership check on tx before returning), deleteBeneficiary (deletes by id alone, ignores callerUserId), updateProfile (Zod .passthrough() schema spread directly into prisma.update data) - all confirmed live by direct read
section3_entry_points.trust_boundary: authenticated user -> other users' records / own record's protected fields

section3_entry_points.description: confirmed: amount schema has only .max(500000), no .positive() or decimal-place refine; balance check-then-decrement inside prisma.$transaction with an explicit 100ms sleep between check and decrement widening the race window; receiver wallet ACTIVE status not re-checked at credit time; addMoney doesn't check wallet suspension
confirmed: changePassword verifies current password and rehashes, but never calls any refresh-token revocation - a stolen session survives a password change
section3_entry_points.trust_boundary: authenticated user action -> should invalidate other sessions

section3_entry_points.entry_point: Stored content rendering / recipient lookup exposure
section3_entry_points.description: confirmed: TransactionDetailPage renders a transfer note via dangerouslySetInnerHTML; lookupRecipient returns another user's email, phone, and live wallet balance from an identifier lookup
section3_entry_points.trust_boundary: sender-controlled data -> victim's browser DOM; authenticated caller -> another user's PII/balance

section3_entry_points.description: confirmed: loginRequest/registerRequest write the access token into localStorage despite httpOnly-cookie design intent stated elsewhere
confirmed: unhandled-exception path returns raw Error.message and .stack in the JSON response body

confirmed jsonwebtoken pinned at 8.5.1 (pre-9.x, documented in-repo as having 3 known GHSAs from the vuln-017 exercise); no dependabot/CI to catch drift; npm allowScripts allowlist for native-binding packages
section3_entry_points.trust_boundary: build-time dependency code execution / vulnerable library code running in-process

section3_entry_points.description: scripts/setup-db.sh hardcodes a weak Postgres password ('payflow') and grants the app role CREATEDB (more than runtime needs); no Dockerfile/k8s/terraform/CI present
